svg.aria-label: A vending machine selling one item, 1M tokens of the same open model, through four coin slots. Three price plates are fixed: cloud GPU $0.97, frontier API about $12, wrapped federal LLM up to $45. The owned-capacity plate is a drum counter driven by a crank box beside the machine whose 24-hour dial sets how many hours a day the box is busy; the drums roll to 0.97 × 5.3 ÷ hours. At 5.3 hours a day the owned price equals the cloud GPU price; at 12 hours it is $0.43.
